Pharmacovigilance within the context of [[atrieflimren-i-danmark|Atrieflimren i Danmark]] focuses heavily on monitoring the safety and clinical outcomes of [[antikoagulationsbehandling|antikoagulationsbehandling]] (anticoagulation therapy). A primary objective of this surveillance is to evaluate and compare the risk of severe adverse events, particularly bleeding complications, between newer direct oral anticoagulants ([[doac|DOAC]], also referred to as NOAC) and the traditional vitamin K antagonist [[marevan|marevan]].

Monitoring [[intrakraniel-bloedning|Intrakraniel blødning]] (intracranial bleeding) is a critical component of this pharmacovigilance effort, as it represents one of the most dangerous complications of anticoagulation. Data from 2023 indicates that the proportion of patients experiencing intracranial bleeding was 0.52% for those treated with DOAC and 0.46% for those on marevan [^src1]. When looking specifically at atrial fibrillation patients, the rates were similarly recorded at 0.52% for NOAC-treated patients [^src2] and 0.46% for Marevan-treated patients [^src2]. Updated figures from 2024 show a shift in these proportions, with intracranial bleeding rates reported at 0.53% for DOAC and 0.82% for marevan [^src3].

Beyond intracranial events, pharmacovigilance also tracks broader categories of bleeding, such as [[alvorlig-bloedning|Alvorlig blødning]] (severe bleeding). In 2024, the proportion of patients experiencing severe bleeding was closely comparable between the two treatment groups, recorded at 2.30% for DOAC and 2.38% for marevan [^src4]. 

Finally, the ultimate goal of anticoagulation is to prevent strokes while minimizing bleeding risks. Surveillance tracks how well patients are protected prior to adverse events. For instance, national data from 2024 reveals that among atrial fibrillation patients admitted with [[iskaemisk-apopleksi|Iskæmisk apopleksi]] (ischemic stroke) or stroke of unknown type, 65.5% had redeemed a prescription for oral anticoagulation therapy within 100 days prior to their admission [^src5]. This highlights the ongoing importance of pharmacovigilance in assessing both the safety and the real-world preventative effectiveness of these medications.

- Andelen af patienter med intrakraniel blødning er 0,52% for DOAC og 0,46% for marevan [^src1] (doac, marevan)

  Page: 98
